Bubblegum pink hair, waist-length and wavy, with straight-cut bangs. Magenta-shaded eyes with a playful, wide-eyed expression. Appears to be in the late teens with a youthful, soft-featured face. Slender, lithe build wearing a white and purple royal outfit with gold trim and a crimson cape. Features a black braided cord on the left cheek and a small black ribbon in the hair.
BODY COLOR: pale skin
